title: Navy astronomer measures wobbling disc

tellings.quote: New Mexico, this is in uh the very famous Life magazine article of 1947. One of the Navy's top astronomers observes

plain: In New Mexico, one of the US Navy's top astronomers watched a wobbling disc in the sky and measured it, according to the researcher Marik von Rennenkampff. He points to the source as a well-known Life magazine article from 1947. He brings it up to show that trained scientists were reporting these objects from the very start.
